one_line: A generic conceptual framework/implementation plan for an ISO 50001 Energy Management System applicable to "all operations, facilities, services etc." of an organization (authored by Kuwait Oil Company staff), focused on offices, equipment and departmental energy governance rather than any demonstrated continuous-flow production process.
